title: Intergalactic Aerospace Expo 2956
subtitle: Free Fly & Manufacturer Schedule
lead: Join us in New Babbage on microTech, system Stanton, for the biggest spaceship show in the universe!

days.title: Roberts Space Industries
days.lead: The Galaxy arrives at last, casting a massive shadow over the Expo hall with its flyable debut!

ships.name: RSI Galaxy
ships.line: With a fully modular design and an onboard hangar capable of deploying small ships, the cutting-edge Galaxy can be outfitted with comprehensive facilities to support cargo, medical, or refining operations.

ships.name: RSI Skylark
ships.line: Armed for attack, shielded for safety, and fueled for the frontier, the Skylark is a snub fighter built with everyday adventure in mind.

ships.name: RSI Apollo Medivac
ships.line: A life-saving ship with enhanced armor and missile racks, capable of responding to calls in the heaviest combat.

ships.name: RSI Apollo Triage
ships.line: The Triage delivers highly configurable, professional-level medical care anywhere in the galaxy.

ships.name: RSI Aurora Mk II
ships.line: The next generation in accessible spacecraft.

ships.name: RSI Constellation Mk V Centaurus
ships.line: A legend reborn for the modern era.

ships.name: RSI Constellation Mk IV Andromeda
ships.line: The Constellation Mk IV Andromeda, a multi-person freighter, is beloved by smugglers and merchants alike for its modular flexibility, potent firepower, and iconic looks.

ships.name: RSI Constellation Mk IV Aquila
ships.line: Sporting a redesigned cockpit for maximum visibility, advanced sensors, and an onboard Ursa rover for planetary exploration, the Constellation Mk IV Aquila is ready for adventure.

ships.name: RSI Constellation Mk IV Phoenix
ships.line: Operable as an organization command ship or dedicated luxury spacecraft for the discerning star captain, the Constellation Mark IV Phoenix comes with a Lynx rover and a Kruger P-72 Archimedes Fighter.

ships.name: RSI Constellation Mk IV Taurus
ships.line: A dedicated freighter including a shielded cargo hold and an industrial-grade tractor beam, the Constellation Mk IV Taurus is a great way to start your hauling empire.

ships.name: RSI Hermes
ships.line: High capacity, high speed, and high defense.

ships.name: RSI Lynx
ships.line: Tour the wildest corners of the ‘verse in safety, comfort, and style in the Lynx from RSI.

ships.name: RSI Mantis
ships.line: Stop ships dead in their tracks with RSI’s premier quantum enforcer.

ships.name: RSI Meteor
ships.line: A medium fighter providing a devastating mix of speed and firepower wrapped in the aggressive styling the brand is known for.

ships.name: RSI Perseus
ships.line: Capable of shredding sub-capital class goliaths, the mere presence of a Perseus gunship in a blockade or patrol squad is enough to make your most aggressive enemies think twice before engaging, just like its vintage namesake.

ships.name: RSI Polaris
ships.line: The Polaris is a nimble corvette-class capital ship that packs a powerful punch with a full armament of turrets and torpedoes.

ships.name: RSI Salvation
ships.line: With beginner-friendly functionality and a back-to-basics interior, the Salvation brings exactly that to those dreaming of finding their tomorrow in yesterday’s wrecks.

ships.name: RSI Scorpius
ships.line: With an adaptable bi-wing configuration and revolutionary rail-mounted remote turret, the Scorpius offers unprecedented fire coverage, allowing for both defensive and assault-minded applications.

ships.name: RSI Scorpius Antares
ships.line: Redesigned to house a devastating EMP device and quantum jammer, the Antares shuts down enemy combatants, leaving them open to attack or boarding.

ships.name: RSI Ursa
ships.line: Rugged, durable, and tough, this is the rover of choice for extreme planetary exploration.

ships.name: RSI Ursa Medivac
ships.line: Provides frontline medical support essential to any ground operation.

ships.name: RSI Zeus Mk II CL
ships.line: With a focus on commerce, the Zeus Mk II CL features additional cargo space and a tractor beam for handling large volumes of freight.

ships.name: RSI Zeus Mk II ES
ships.line: With a focus on exploration, the Zeus Mk II ES features a robust radar package for making new discoveries along with enhanced weaponry and shielding.

days.title: Origin Jumpworks
days.lead: Your IAE journey continues on a more refined route as Origin lights the path.

ships.name: Origin 85x
ships.line: A luxury and sporty short-range runabout for pilot and passenger.

ships.name: Origin 100i
ships.line: Tour the universe with the perfect coupling of luxury and performance.

ships.name: Origin 125a
ships.line: With high fuel economy, a souped-up weapons package, and trademark Origin refinement, the 125a is the ideal entry into luxury spaceflight.

ships.name: Origin 135c
ships.line: With a deceptive amount of storage space in its sleek, stylish frame, the 135c is the obvious choice for the hauler of taste.

ships.name: Origin 300i
ships.line: Travel in style with this high-performance solo tourer.

ships.name: Origin 315p
ships.line: Traverse the ‘verse with this high-performance light explorer.

ships.name: Origin 325a
ships.line: Origin’s sleek signature fighter, the 325a makes a great companion for finding your mark in style and sophistication.

ships.name: Origin 350r
ships.line: Origin’s signature racer, the 350r leaves the competition in the dust.

ships.name: Origin 400i
ships.line: To explore the stars is a most noble endeavor, and Origin Jumpworks has risen to the occasion in crafting the 400i, the ultimate high-performance pathfinder.

ships.name: Origin 600i Explorer
ships.line: The 600i Explorer swaps the lounge for a robust scanning station as well as additional utility hardpoints to increase the ship's effectiveness.

ships.name: Origin 600i Touring
ships.line: Star Citizen’s iconic luxury tourer.

ships.name: Origin 890 Jump
ships.line: A vessel in a class all of its own, the colossal 890 Jump is a masterpiece of long-distance touring.

ships.name: Origin M50
ships.line: Origin’s premier racer.

ships.name: Origin M80
ships.line: Beauty and power combine to create a Heavy Fighter far more than mere machine.

ships.name: Origin X1
ships.line: The X1 takes speed and agility to the next level thanks to seamlessly integrated engine technology and joint vector thruster placement.

ships.name: Origin X1 Force
ships.line: This open-canopy vehicle from Origin is equally suited to ground-based exploration, reconnaissance expeditions, and security operations.

ships.name: Origin X1 Velocity
ships.line: The X1 Velocity offers a lighter chassis to improve overall performance, making it a dangerous new addition to the open-canopy racer lineup.

days.title: Anvil Aerospace
days.lead: Day 3 plays host to Anvil's legendary stable of combat-tested ships.

ships.name: Anvil Arrow
ships.line: Featuring an ultra-aerodynamic frame and slight profile, it’s the most agile ship in its class.

ships.name: Anvil Asgard
ships.line: A heavily armored vehicle-dropship equipped for boundless resilience in the hottest combat zones.

ships.name: Anvil Ballista
ships.line: This self-propelled air defense system is capable of destruction on a massive scale.

ships.name: Anvil C8R Pisces
ships.line: With the addition of an onboard Tier 3 Medical Bed, the C8R Pisces can treat minor injuries and keep a patient stable while transporting them to safety.

ships.name: Anvil C8X Pisces Expedition
ships.line: Ideal for inter-system travel or investigating tight spots inaccessible to larger ships, it’s a small ship ready for big adventures.

ships.name: Anvil Carrack
ships.line: Iconic multi-crew explorer ready for your next epic adventure.

ships.name: Anvil Centurion
ships.line: Built on Anvil’s popular Atlas Platform, the Centurion presents a tactical solution for short-range anti-aircraft engagement.

ships.name: Anvil F7C Hornet Mk II
ships.line: Tame the power, speed, and offensive punch of the UEE Navy's premier carrier-based fighter, made famous by its dominating role in the Vanduul war.

ships.name: Anvil F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II
ships.line: The Super Hornet is back and upgraded to Mk II spec, making it deadlier than ever.

ships.name: Anvil F7C-R Hornet Tracker Mk II
ships.line: The F7CR “Tracker” model is a formidable stalker equipped with supercharged long-range radar.

ships.name: Anvil F7C-S Hornet Ghost Mk II
ships.line: The F7CS “Ghost” model is a stealth fighter more than capable of both reconnaissance and ambush operations.

ships.name: Anvil F8C Lightning
ships.line: A force to be reckoned with, it has protected Humanity countless times from countless threats at home and far from civilization.

ships.name: Anvil Gladiator
ships.line: A ruggedly built two-person dive bomber.

ships.name: Anvil Hawk
ships.line: The perfect ship for independent bounty hunters or local security.

ships.name: Anvil Hurricane
ships.line: A heavy fighter with an almost excessive loadout.

ships.name: Anvil Paladin
ships.line: A formidable gunship with durable armor and immense firepower.

ships.name: Anvil Spartan
ships.line: Ready for any battlefield, this vehicle gets troops there safely, quickly, and effectively.

ships.name: Anvil Terrapin
ships.line: Heavily armored ship with a sophisticated scanner.

ships.name: Anvil Terrapin Medic
ships.line: Sporting the same robust frame and armor as its pathfinding predecessor, the Terrapin Medic adds a Tier 2 MedBed to become a true miniature frontline trauma center or robust search and rescue vessel.

ships.name: Anvil Valkyrie
ships.line: A heavily armed dropship perfect for full-crew expeditions.

days.title: Crusader Industries, Tumbril
days.lead: Hailing from its lofty perch above the namesake gas giant, Crusader Industries now deploys its wares on microTech.

ships.name: Crusader A1 Spirit
ships.line: A mid-size multi-purpose starship equipped as a light bomber but has the cargo and weaponry to deal with many different scenarios.

ships.name: Crusader A2 Hercules
ships.line: With more than double the firepower of the M2, and a custom bomb bay capable of delivering a staggering payload, the A2 caters to anyone hauling massive amounts of cargo through potentially unfriendly skies.

ships.name: Crusader Ares Ion
ships.line: This single cannon equipped heavy fighter delivers extremely powerful shots to quickly disable the shields of even the biggest enemy vessels.

ships.name: Crusader Ares Inferno
ships.line: Whether heading up a crew or hunting big ships solo, the Ares Inferno's massive Gatling tears through gunship armor and turns smaller fighters to dust in seconds.

ships.name: Crusader C1 Spirit
ships.line: A mid-size multi-purpose starship built for cargo transport and delivery but packing enough versatility to tackle multiple roles and unpredictable jobs.

ships.name: Crusader C2 Hercules
ships.line: Utilizing the patented Hercules military-grade spaceframe and expanding cargo capacity, while sacrificing barely any firepower, the C2 has become the cargo industry standard.

ships.name: Crusader Intrepid
ships.line: Versatile starter ship and light hauler built with true Crusader quality.

ships.name: Crusader M2 Hercules
ships.line: As the UEE's premier tactical Starlifter, the M2’s potent combination of capacity, maneuverability, and durability make it the obvious choice in large-scale transport.

ships.name: Crusader Mercury Star Runner
ships.line: Built with the same engineering and design principles that has made Crusader the go-to manufacturer for galactic transport on any scale, the Mercury checks all the boxes expected of a dependable courier vessel.

ships.name: Tumbril Cyclone
ships.line: Stir up a storm with this robust two-seater buggy that can carry a little something in the back.

ships.name: Tumbril Cyclone AA
ships.line: Features EMP functionality and an anti-air missile launcher to deter threats from above.

ships.name: Tumbril Cyclone MT
ships.line: Building on the agile off-road platform of the base variant, the MT adds two surface-to-air missile launchers and a ballistic cannon to keep airborne assailants at bay.

ships.name: Tumbril Cyclone RC
ships.line: Cyclone racing variant.

ships.name: Tumbril Cyclone RN
ships.line: Built to clear the fog of war, the recon variant of the Cyclone features a powerful scanner array.

ships.name: Tumbril Cyclone TR
ships.line: Support infantry with this combat buggy.

ships.name: Tumbril Nova
ships.line: This heavy tank offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.

ships.name: Tumbril Storm
ships.line: The Tumbril Storm single-operator mini-tank is built to blitz battlefields and take out enemy artillery.

ships.name: Tumbril Storm AA
ships.line: Blitz overcrowded battlefields, take out threats from the air, and turn the tide of any conflict.

days.title: Drake Interplanetary
days.lead: Ready to get your hands dirty?

ships.name: Drake Buccaneer
ships.line: A light fighter that sacrifices durability (and its ejection seat!) for raw firepower.

ships.name: Drake Caterpillar
ships.line: A heavy multi-crew commercial freighter.

ships.name: Drake Clipper
ships.line: Depend only on yourself.

ships.name: Drake Corsair
ships.line: A worthy exploration companion, supporting you in battle, discovery, and delivery, wherever the winds of adventure may steer you.

ships.name: Drake Cutlass Black
ships.line: Back in black, Drake’s pirate-favorite is a highly versatile ship with combat and cargo prowess.

ships.name: Drake Cutlass Blue
ships.line: The Cutlass Blue boasts missiles, a more powerful engine, and Durasteel holding cells in the cargo bay.

ships.name: Drake Cutlass Red
ships.line: The Cutlass Red converts the standard cargo hold into a well-equipped medical facility, including two MedBeds.

ships.name: Drake Cutlass Steel
ships.line: Whoever has the guns and the personnel makes the rules.

ships.name: Drake Cutter
ships.line: Designed for hard-working folks of all stripes, the Cutter packs 4 SCU of cargo room and plenty of wallop into a rough and tumble, compact frame.

ships.name: Drake Cutter Rambler
ships.line: The pilot-favorite Cutter chassis outfitted for long hauls and extended engagements.

ships.name: Drake Cutter Scout
ships.line: The Scout model comes factory-equipped with a beefed-up scanning suite that makes it perfect for pathfinding, surveying, and even reconnaissance and covert intelligence operations.

ships.name: Drake Dragonfly Black
ships.line: A two-seater grav-lev bike that easily traverses rough terrain or open space.

ships.name: Drake Golem
ships.line: An accessible tool built to end the corporate monopoly on mining and place your future firmly within your grasp.

ships.name: Drake Golem OX
ships.line: Disrupt the hauling industry with Drake.

ships.name: Drake Herald
ships.line: No secret is safe.

ships.name: Drake Ironclad
ships.line: Run the skies with Drake’s juggernaut of free enterprise, the mighty Ironclad.

ships.name: Drake Ironclad Assault
ships.line: Drake’s stalwart Heavy Freighter, outfitted for combat and vehicle transport.

ships.name: Drake Mule
ships.line: Whether you need to transport cargo over the roughest terrain possible or load it onto larger vessels and cargo decks, the Mule works, plain and simple.

ships.name: Drake Pitbull
ships.line: A small-but-mighty Snub Fighter that excels at close-combat dogfighting.

ships.name: Drake Vulture
ships.line: Rip wrecks like a pro and carve out your own place in the great big empty behind the stick of this rough, rugged salvage machine from Drake Interplanetary.

days.title: ARGO Astronautics, Consolidated Outland, Greycat Industrial, Grey's Market
days.lead: With something for just about everyone, Day 6 brings a wide array of manufacturers to IAE.

ships.name: Argo ATLS
ships.line: The ATLS power suit lets you tackle big jobs without the fuss of a vehicle.

ships.name: Argo ATLS GEO
ships.line: Built on the proven ATLS power suit chassis, the GEO is outfitted with bespoke mining components and a Jump Pack to open up the most inaccessible (and prosperous) corners of the galaxy.

ships.name: Argo CSV-SM
ships.line: Rugged, reliable, and typically Argo, the CSV-SM gives you the power to move essential cargo anywhere, whatever the terrain.

ships.name: Argo MOLE
ships.line: Tap into your crew’s full potential with the combined force of Argo’s patented tri-lateral mining system.

ships.name: Argo MOTH
ships.line: Expand your salvage operation with the Multi Operator Targeted Harvester.

ships.name: Argo MPUV Cargo
ships.line: A small, unarmed utility runabout designed for shuttling cargo.

ships.name: Argo MPUV Personnel
ships.line: A compact utility shuttle built for moving personnel.

ships.name: Argo MPUV Tractor
ships.line: The MPUV Tractor features dual tractor beams for effortless cargo handling alongside the sturdy, reliable design you expect from Argo.

ships.name: Argo RAFT
ships.line: Perfect for entry-level haulers and old pros alike, the RAFT is an ideal solution for reliable local freight transport.

ships.name: Argo SRV
ships.line: From simple freight and cargo towing to harrowing search-and-rescue operations, the SRV handles whatever you can throw at it.

ships.name: CNOU HoverQuad
ships.line: You know that place where the roads end, and sky runs out?

ships.name: CNOU Mustang Alpha
ships.line: Consolidated Outland’s premier ship for those wanting to push the limits a little further when starting out.

ships.name: CNOU Mustang Beta
ships.line: Home is where the heart is.

ships.name: CNOU Mustang Gamma
ships.line: An additional engine provides racers the competitive edge they need.

ships.name: CNOU Mustang Delta
ships.line: The Mustang Delta is armed with heavier weapons and rocket pods to give new pilots a little more firepower.

ships.name: CNOU Nomad
ships.line: The Nomad is ready to go anywhere and do anything - the perfect solution for anyone yearning to start a brand-new adventure.

ships.name: Greycat MDC
ships.line: Explore in safety and keep your planetside interests secure with the Greycat Mobile Defense Centre.

ships.name: Greycat MTC
ships.line: The MTC is perfect for carrying weapons and armor to battlefields, bunkers, outposts, expedition sites, and more.

ships.name: Greycat PTV
ships.line: The Greycat PTV buggy gets you from point to point, wherever you are.

ships.name: Greycat ROC
ships.line: Designed to be as hard-working and versatile as the miners who use it.

ships.name: Greycat ROC-DS
ships.line: With more than double the ore capacity of the standard ROC, and a dedicated boom seat for manual laser operation, the ROC-DS makes big jobs manageable.

ships.name: Greycat STV
ships.line: A sports vehicle built by pros for pros that takes the industry-proven usability of Greycat and opens the door to adventure.

ships.name: Greycat UTV
ships.line: Deliver and explore anywhere with the galaxy-renowned utility of Greycat Industrial.

ships.name: Grey's Market Basher
ships.line: Grey's doesn’t comply, it defies.

ships.name: Grey's Market Shiv
ships.line: Don't ask how we got it, don't ask where it came from, just ask, "Do you want it?"

days.title: MISC, Mirai, Kruger Intergalactic
days.lead: The workhorse Hull and Freelancer series are ubiquitous throughout the 'verse.

ships.name: MISC Fortune
ships.line: Get the job done quickly with MISC’s most efficient salvager yet.

ships.name: MISC Freelancer
ships.line: A multi-crew freighter with a turret and ordnance to deter those after its haul.

ships.name: MISC Freelancer DUR
ships.line: The Freelancer DUR specializes in exploration with improved scanner, jump drive, and fuel tanks.

ships.name: MISC Freelancer MAX
ships.line: The Freelancer MAX is for pilots who prize increased cargo capacity over everything else.

ships.name: MISC Freelancer MIS
ships.line: The Freelancer MIS is a limited-edition militarized variant of the classic merchant ship.

ships.name: MISC Hull A
ships.line: Where the others trade cargo capacity for firepower or speed, the Hull A is 100% on-mission transport.

ships.name: MISC Hull B
ships.line: With a huge payload and MISC’s trademark collapsible cargo system, the Hull B is built for serious haulers and delivery outfits looking to take their business to the next level and beyond.

ships.name: MISC Hull C
ships.line: Often called the most common ship in the galaxy, the Hull C cargo vessel is the most-produced of the range and is considered by many to be the most versatile.

ships.name: MISC Prospector
ships.line: A miner’s best friend, with a powerful laser and saddlebags to turn minerals to profit.

ships.name: MISC Reliant Kore
ships.line: A fusion of Xi’an and Human technology, this light freighter lets you haul cargo with a friend.

ships.name: MISC Reliant Mako
ships.line: Go where the news is and capture every moment with turret-mounted optics.

ships.name: MISC Reliant Sen
ships.line: The Reliant Sen is a versatile mobile science platform.

ships.name: MISC Reliant Tana
ships.line: An easy to maintain, versatile, lightweight fighter.

ships.name: MISC Starfarer
ships.line: The dedicated fuel refining platform from MISC.

ships.name: MISC Starfarer Gemini
ships.line: This military variant sacrifices fuel capacity for armor and a missile launcher.

ships.name: MISC Starlancer MAX
ships.line: Designed to carry huge payloads, the Starlancer MAX allows you to go big with a massively expansive cargo deck.

ships.name: MISC Starlancer TAC
ships.line: Heavy weaponry, a dedicated snub hangar, medbeds, and eight military-spec jump seats mean you’re ready for anything.

ships.name: MISC Starlite
ships.line: Refuelers are the unsung heroes of the Empire, and they demand a ship that’s as focused as they are.

ships.name: Mirai Fury
ships.line: Shatter the limits of performance with this next-generation snub fighter from Mirai featuring four halo-mounted size 2 laser repeaters, best-in-class maneuverability, and unprecedented integration of Xi’an tech.

ships.name: Mirai Fury LX
ships.line: The next-generation Fury LX racing ship from Mirai switches out the lithe ship’s offensive capabilities to make room for additional maneuvering thrusters perfect for getting across the finish line.

ships.name: Mirai Fury MX
ships.line: A ruthlessly efficient snub-bomber packing an intimidating payload that’s capable of delivering it with deadly precision.

ships.name: Mirai Guardian
ships.line: Single-operator, long-range heavy fighter with a focus on raw firepower and precision.

ships.name: Mirai Guardian QI
ships.line: Single-operator fighter-interceptor with a focus on raw firepower and precision.

ships.name: Mirai Guardian MX
ships.line: Mirai’s already deadly Guardian, tuned for uncompromised combat performance with harder-hitting weapons and heavier defense.

ships.name: Mirai Pulse
ships.line: Redefines the hoverbike experience with its fusion of sleek design, integrated weaponry, and advanced thrusters for unmatched maneuverability.

ships.name: Mirai Pulse LX
ships.line: The leader of high-speed thrills.

ships.name: Mirai Razor
ships.line: Cutting ahead of the competition, this sleek racer gives anyone a run for pole position.

ships.name: Mirai Razor EX
ships.line: Stealth-edition of the Razor outfitted with signature-reducing materials and low-draw components.

ships.name: Mirai Razor LX
ships.line: Special-edition of the Razor features reduced maneuverability and armament in exchange for extreme straight-line speed.

ships.name: Kruger L-21 Wolf
ships.line: A combat ship prioritizing quality and agility in a timeless design that encompasses Kruger Intergalactic’s core tenet - Perfection in Every Piece.

ships.name: Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf
ships.line: Kruger’s modern classic Wolf, tweaked for a new audience, with bespoke laser repeaters, upgraded missiles, and a new winglet makeover.

ships.name: Kruger P-52 Merlin
ships.line: Small, agile, and with a sting in its tail.

ships.name: Kruger P-72 Archimedes
ships.line: The Archimedes delivers exceptional handling and boost capabilities in a beautifully designed package.

ships.name: Kruger S-65 Stingray
ships.line: Kruger continues to expand its stunning lineup with its first Medium Fighter.

days.title: Aegis Dynamics
days.lead: Now we're bringing in the big guns.

ships.name: Aegis Avenger Stalker
ships.line: A modified version of the Avenger catering to bounty hunters thanks to built-in prison cells.

ships.name: Aegis Avenger Titan
ships.line: A former Advocacy patrol ship with added cargo capacity for light couriering.

ships.name: Aegis Avenger Titan Renegade
ships.line: Special-edition of the Avenger Titan with custom livery and a loadout geared to Arena Commander.

ships.name: Aegis Avenger Warlock
ships.line: A variant of the Avenger armed with an EMP generator to humanely disable enemies.

ships.name: Aegis Eclipse
ships.line: A sleek stealth bomber armed with heavy torpedoes.

ships.name: Aegis Gladius
ships.line: An aging but agile light-fighter boasting mid-range armament.

ships.name: Aegis Gladius Valiant
ships.line: Special-edition Gladius with custom livery and a loadout geared to Arena Commander.

ships.name: Aegis Hammerhead
ships.line: A multi-crew corvette bristling with manned turrets and heavy firepower.

ships.name: Aegis Reclaimer
ships.line: A vast deep-space salvage vessel built to reclaim wrecks and derelict ships.

ships.name: Aegis Redeemer
ships.line: Dotted with turrets and missiles, the Aegis Redeemer is a powerful fighting gunship capable of holding its own in combat with an impressive weapons payload.

ships.name: Aegis Retaliator
ships.line: One of Humanity’s most powerful warbirds, the Retaliator is a fearsome weapons platform originally designed to strike and kill capital ships.

ships.name: Aegis Sabre
ships.line: Favoring agility over durability, the Sabre is light, sleek, and deadly.

ships.name: Aegis Sabre Comet
ships.line: Special-edition of the Sabre with custom livery and a loadout geared to Arena Commander.

ships.name: Aegis Sabre Firebird
ships.line: Facilitating a devastating marriage of speed and ballistic firepower, the Firebird brings the heat to the infamous Sabre chassis.

ships.name: Aegis Sabre Peregrine
ships.line: The fastest Sabre model yet conceived, the Peregrine takes the infamous military-born chassis and tunes it for pure unadulterated speed.

ships.name: Aegis Sabre Raven EX
ships.line: Built on a legacy of space superiority, the Aegis Sabre Raven EX matches the firepower of the Sabre, the silhouette of the Raven, and adds a quantum dampener to isolate enemies and keep them in the line of fire.

ships.name: Aegis Tiburon
ships.line: Conceived to rip capital ships from the sky, the Aegis Tiburon is built to destroy.

ships.name: Aegis Vanguard Harbinger
ships.line: A powerful bomber that can operate out of the roughest forward-operating bases.

ships.name: Aegis Vanguard Hoplite
ships.line: Long-range squad dropship with a manned turret for protection.

ships.name: Aegis Vanguard Sentinel
ships.line: A ship designed to fight smart instead of taking enemies head-on.

ships.name: Aegis Vanguard Warden
ships.line: One of Aegis' most versatile and deadly long-range fighters.

ships.name: Aopoa Khartu-al
ships.line: Enigmatic, exotic, and agile.

ships.name: Aopoa Nox
ships.line: Sleek and fast, this gravity bike glides across rough terrain.

ships.name: Aopoa San'tok.yāi
ships.line: Meet the next evolution of Xi'an tech and design innovation.

ships.name: Banu Defender
ships.line: The exotic fighter is the first line of defense against enemy attack.

ships.name: Esperia Blade
ships.line: This alien fighter slices through the air with high agility to shred foes to ribbons.

ships.name: Esperia Glaive
ships.line: This medium alien fighter replica drives fear with its impressive armament.

ships.name: Esperia Prowler
ships.line: The Prowler is a modernized version of the infamous Tevarin armored personnel carrier.

ships.name: Esperia Prowler Utility
ships.line: The Utility embraces the alien design of the infamous Tevarin ship entrusted to Esperia decades ago.

ships.name: Esperia Stinger
ships.line: A closely replicated Vanduul ship, reworked for Human flight.

ships.name: Esperia Talon
ships.line: The Talon is the Tevarin equivalent to the Aegis Gladius or Vanduul Blade; a single-seat combat ship.

ships.name: Esperia Talon Shrike
ships.line: The infamous Shrike variant is armed with authentic internal missile racks capable of unleashing lethal barrages of projectiles.

ships.name: Gatac Railen
ships.line: An elegant interspecies vessel perfect for any Human or Xi’an pilot looking for a safe, reliable solution for commercial-grade medium cargo hauling.

ships.name: Gatac Syulen
ships.line: The Syulen cargo vessel has been artfully crafted by the renowned House Gatac to perfectly suit both Human and Xi'an pilots.

ships.name: Gatac Tyilui
ships.line: Effortlessly navigate the multi-directional zero-gravity hangar in Gatac’s first carrier craft.

days.title: Best In Show
days.lead: Over the summer, we held our annual Ship Showdown contest to uncover the community’s favorite flyable ship of 2026.

days.title: Finale
days.lead: All previously available flyable ships will be ready to test-fly via the rental kiosks located in the Tobin Center in New Babbage on microTech.

notes: The price of the MISC Prospector will increase by $20, from $155 to $175 on MISC Day of IAE.
